scope: T09X01/T09A06: buyer API, four-tool FairPool MCP, merchant API and delegation/mandate verification; simulated rehearsal-checker corrections.

verification.tests: test_agent_entries, test_agent_delegations, test_merchant_api_keys, test_merchant_agent_api, test_mandate_persistence, test_mcp_contract, test_delegations, test_mandate_conditions, test_mandate_schema, test_mandate_grounding
verification.regression_method: Observed failing tests before fixing missing persisted entry, isError/empty/null tool result handling, CLI failure gate and report scope; reran with the corrections.
verification.cli: The isolated fake-provider market CLI is exercised by test_market_cli_runs_actual_buyer_and_merchant_paths. Both buyer actions and merchant actions succeed; breaches_succeeded=0 and paypal_writes_from_ai_surface=0.

corrections: A buyer now supplies required_by and joins an OPEN fixture pool.
HTTP 200 / JSON-RPC success alone does not count as a successful MCP tool result.
The CLI fails if either participant lane fails or the measured boundary counters are nonzero.
Entry and order counters are restricted to the current pool, excluding unrelated database history.
historical_evidence: The older agent_market.json did not prove its buyer joined successfully: it accepted a tool-level error as success. This follow-up does not rewrite that historical file.

open_contract_questions.Q-2026-11-04-35: Custom MCP transport shim instead of the contracted official SDK; compatibility with every MCP client is not established.
open_contract_questions.Q-2026-11-10-41: MCP advertises required_by as optional while the shared API requires it. Examples supply a date; contract/schema policy remains unresolved.

limits: The market run is SIMULATED with fake providers, not a real payment or live-model run.
The harness uses seeded market fixtures; it does not prove the complete timed allocation/auction/payment lifecycle.
Zero observed boundary violations is a measured result, not a security guarantee.
No production API, protocol contract, payment adapter, frontend behavior or dependency changed.
